stories.title: Estados Unidos despliega 500 militares en frontera con México; Marina activa operativo en Matamoros

en.title: United States deploys 500 military personnel on Mexico border; Navy activates operation in Matamoros
en.summary: The United States has deployed 500 military personnel to its border with Mexico as part of coordinated mirror operations between the two countries. Mexico has positioned 159 naval personnel, 11 vehicles, and two drones in the border zone.

stories.title: FGR sostiene que hay pruebas "contundentes" contra Ruffo Appel y empresa Ingemar, ligada a huachicol fiscal; mantiene investigación

en.title: FGR maintains it has 'conclusive' evidence against Ruffo Appel and Ingemar company, linked to fuel theft; continues investigation
en.summary: Mexican authorities claim to have conclusive evidence against former Baja California governor Ruffo Appel and the company Ingemar in connection with illegal fuel trafficking. Appel, currently under house arrest, holds 49% of the company's shares.

stories.title: México vs Estados Unidos: Horario y dónde ver EN VIVO el partido del Tri; HOY sábado 3 de octubre

en.title: Mexico vs United States: Schedule and where to watch LIVE the Tri match; TODAY Saturday October 3
en.summary: The Mexican national soccer team plays its third match under coach Rafa Márquez against the United States on Saturday, October 3.

stories.title: Rusia anuncia ataques masivos a Kiev; insta a diplomáticos y extranjeros a abandonar la capital de Ucrania

en.title: Russia announces massive attacks on Kyiv; urges diplomats and foreigners to leave Ukrainian capital
en.summary: Russia has announced large-scale attacks on Kyiv and called for diplomatic personnel and foreign nationals to evacuate the Ukrainian capital.

stories.title: Rusia pide a diplomáticos y extranjeros abandonar Kiev y anuncia ataques “masivos”

en.title: Russia asks diplomats and foreigners to leave Kyiv and announces "massive" attacks
en.summary: Moscow issued a warning for diplomats and foreign nationals to evacuate Kyiv, following recent Russian bombardments that damaged two major bridges in the Ukrainian capital.

stories.title: ¿Rafa Márquez arriesgará a Gilberto Mora ante Estados Unidos? Esta sería la alineación de México

en.title: Will Rafa Márquez risk Gilberto Mora against the United States? This would be Mexico's lineup
en.summary: Mexican player Gilberto Mora recovered from an ankle injury and is expected to play in the upcoming match against the United States, though coach Rafael Márquez must decide whether to start him.

stories.title: Logra Verstappen su primera pole de la temporada en Bahréin

en.title: Verstappen achieves his first pole of the season in Bahrain
en.summary: Max Verstappen secured pole position for the Bahrain Grand Prix, with his Red Bull demonstrating superior speed and stability on the track.

stories.title: Max Verstappen firma la pole en Malasia y buscará su primera victoria de 2026

en.title: Max Verstappen secures pole in Malaysia and seeks his first victory of 2026
en.summary: Max Verstappen claimed pole position at Sepang ahead of Lewis Hamilton for the Malaysian Grand Prix, with Kimi Antonelli starting third following a penalty to another driver.

stories.title: Elton John da cátedra de cómo desafiar al tiempo; el cantante se despide de México

en.title: Elton John teaches how to defy time; the singer says goodbye to Mexico
en.summary: Singer Elton John bids farewell to Mexico following a performance that demonstrates his ability to overcome the effects of aging.

stories.title: Elton John se despide de México: “creo que va a ser un largo tiempo”...

en.title: Elton John says goodbye to Mexico: "I think it will be a long time"...
en.summary: Elton John performed farewell concerts in Mexico City, concluding his Farewell Yellow Brick Road tour after more than 60 years of performing career.

stories.title: Sufre el peso su peor revés semanal desde marzo; perdió 2.57%

en.title: Mexican peso suffers its worst weekly decline since March; lost 2.57%
en.summary: The Mexican peso declined 2.57% over the week due to concerns about potential further monetary tightening by the U.S. Federal Reserve.

stories.title: Indagatoria contra Ruffo tiene pruebas contundentes, afirma la FGR

en.title: Investigation against Ruffo contains compelling evidence, claims the FGR
en.summary: Mexico's Federal Prosecutor's Office states that its investigation into Ernesto Ruffo Appel includes solid evidence such as expert reports and data analysis linking him to strategic decisions in his capacity as shareholder and board secretary of Ingemar.

stories.title: ¿Quién es el dueño de Parque Tepeyac, la plaza con acuario, y quiénes son las personas de las estatuas en lo alto?

en.title: Who owns Parque Tepeyac, the mall with an aquarium, and who are the people in the statues on top?
en.summary: A commercial center that opened in 2022 is part of a major real estate investment trust's portfolio and features notable sculptures that attract attention.

stories.title: Banxico cierra el programa de envío de remesas "Directo a México"; garantiza operaciones ordenadas

en.title: Banxico closes 'Directo a México' remittance program; guarantees orderly operations
en.summary: Mexico's central bank is closing its remittance sending program while ensuring normal operations continue through November 20 to process all pending transactions.

stories.title: Bancos en México refuerzan prevención de lavado de dinero ante mayores exigencias de EU en combate a cárteles

en.title: Mexican banks strengthen money laundering prevention amid increased U.S. demands in cartel fight
en.summary: Mexican banks are enhancing anti-money laundering measures in response to stronger pressure from U.S. authorities seeking to disrupt criminal organizations' financial networks.

stories.title: El diésel inicia octubre sin IEPS, mientras Hacienda reporta caídas en su recaudación

en.title: Diesel begins October without IEPS tax as Treasury reports revenue declines
en.summary: Diesel fuel continued in October without the IEPS excise tax while gasoline rates increased, contributing to reported declines in government tax revenue.

stories.title: OXIO tiene seis meses para cerrar la compra de Telefónica y quedarse con los 21 millones de usuarios de Movistar

en.title: OXIO has six months to close Telefónica purchase and acquire Movistar's 21 million users
en.summary: Mexico's competition authority approved Telefónica's acquisition by OXIO, determining the deal unlikely to harm competition, with a six-month deadline for completion.
